scripts.//build: Deliberately absent. `npm run build -w apps/web` is the door most deploy platforms take by default, and a bare `vite build` bypasses EVERY gate in this repository: the warning contract, the eager-bundle budget, the SDK-marker scan and the browser evaluation that is the only thing proving the artifact is not dead on arrival. Use `npm run build:web` from the repo root. `build:raw` below is the unguarded escape hatch — named so nothing reaches it by accident.
